messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Brian Chen <brian.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC Kickoff Recap — Acme / Redwood

Hi Sarah / Brian,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet the Acme team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the kickoff: 

Pain points you confirmed:
- Search & support triage surface incorrect KB results ~30% of the time, hurting CS efficiency.
- Latency spikes on current in-house reranker for long queries (avg 800ms, 95th ~2.8s).
- Hard to measure quality regressions across prompt sets and product changes.

Goals for the POC (agreed):
1) Improve rerank precision for top-3 suggestions by +8–12% on your labeled set.
2) Reduce tail latencies to <1.5s (95th) for typical query lengths.
3) Establish an eval harness and prompt set for ongoing quality monitoring.

Scope (proposed):
- 4-week POC (data + prompt evals week 1; integration + tuning weeks 2–3; final eval & handoff week 4).
- Deliverables: baseline vs Redwood model eval report, latency/cost profile, sample prompt set + eval harness, recommended rollout plan.

Owners & Contacts:
- Acme: Sarah Lee (POC lead), Brian Chen (Infra/Dev).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (CSM, engagement owner), Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer), Rishi Malhotra (Inference lead).

Metrics we’ll track:
- Rerank precision@3 (primary quality metric)
- 95th percentile token latency for inference path
- Cost per 1k requests (est.)
- Regression rate on held-out eval prompts

Access/setup steps we need from Acme (items to share before Wed 12/2):
1) Export of labeled rerank dataset (CSV) + sample prod query logs (anonymized).
2) Temporary service account with read-only access to your staging S3 bucket (or drop files to shared Drive link).
3) List of critical prompt templates / examples for QA and monitoring.

Attachments: I’m attaching a one-page POC SOW and a sample prompt set CSV for reference.

Proposed kickoff date: Wednesday 12/2, 10:00 AM PT — 30 min to confirm access & timeline.

If that all looks good I’ll send a calendar invite and the kickoff agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Thanks Sarah — great. Quick answers and next steps before the kickoff: 

Sandbox model variants we’ll propose:
- rdx-large-v2 (8-bit quantized) — balance of quality/cost (recommended starting point).
- rdx-medium-quant — lower-cost baseline for load testing.
- fallback: rdx-small (if latency issues during burst).

Estimated cost (4-week sandbox, rough):
- rdx-large-v2 baseline: ~$1,200–1,800 (depending on traffic patterns / batching).
- rdx-medium-quant baseline: ~$400–700.
(We’ll produce a per-1k-requests cost sheet in the kickoff.)

Kickoff agenda (30 min):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Access verification: S3 + IAM or Drive (5m)
3) Data format & prompt set walkthrough (10m)
4) Quick demo of eval harness + next steps (10m)

Pre-kickoff checklist for Acme (reminder):
- Provide staging S3 link + read-only service account credentials OR upload artifacts to shared Drive.
- Share any compliance constraints for the sandbox (PII, retention).

Tech contact: Aditya will lead the integration and will send a short onboarding doc during the call. Rishi will support evaluation configuration. Neha will coordinate exec reporting and the final deliverables.

I’ve attached the SOW and sample prompt set again. I’ll send a calendar invite for 12/2 10:00 AM PT now.

See you Wednesday — Marissa
